![Photo by [Gaelle Marcel](https://unsplash.com/@gaellemarcel?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Gaelle Marcel on Unsplash"}

Naked legs and naked shoulders

I pass them by like heavy boulders

I reach my goal

Your knees I seek, your waist I crave

I kneel before you like a slave

And soon you grin

And watch me cry

As all the neighbors pass us by

My tears run deep

The seeds will tower

You’ve used me again

You fragrant flower
